en: Conditioned by a state that is neither wholesome nor with-conflict, a state that is unwholesome and with-conflict arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor with-conflict, a state that is indeterminate and without-conflict arises by way of root-condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither indeterminate nor with-conflict, a state that is indeterminate and without-conflict arises by way of root-condition. [Dependent on] a state that is neither wholesome nor with-conflict and ...
Dependent on a neutral and non-conflict dhamma, a neutral and non-conflict dhamma arises by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three; under predominance condition there are three ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.
